name: json_regex_escapes
description: Backslashes and regex escapes survive the whole write path byte for byte: tool-call arguments (JSON on the wire) -> normalisation -> write_file / edit_file -> disk, for a .py file, a .json file and an edited .py file, and the automatic syntax/JSON check stays quiet. Old bug: escapes were corrupted on the way (a regex word boundary written as backslash-b turned into a backspace control character, JSON escapes broke), leaving unimportable files that only failed later.
user_inputs: Regex içeren dosyaları yaz ve düzenle.

arguments.content:
import re

# Regex escapes must reach the disk byte for byte.
WORD = re.compile(r"\bfoo\b")
WINDOWS_PATH = re.compile(r"C:\\Users\\[^\]+\\\.evren")
DIGITS = re.compile(r"\d{3}-\d{4}")
TAB_AND_NEWLINE = "a\tb\n"

model_replies.content: Üç dosya yazıldı; sözdizimi denetimi temiz.
